ratios.quote: Under the Revolver, we must maintain a “consolidated net leverage” ratio of no more than 4.50 :1.00 at the end of each financial quarter.
Under the Acquisition Term Loan, we must maintain a “consolidated net leverage” ratio of no more than 4.50 :1.00 at the end of each financial quarter.

parsed.notes: The company states it is in compliance at 2026-09-30 but does not disclose actual ratio values. The 2.75:1.00 consolidated senior secured net leverage ratio is excluded because it is an incurrence condition for incremental term loan capacity, not a maintenance covenant. The leverage-based interest margin and facility fee grid is also excluded.
